checks.mechanism: Dynamic evaluation, primary digits and increasing-prime table
checks.evidence: Zero tests expose component divergence; q comparisons per digit; distinct-degree decomposition suffices; table factorization calls have degreeq−1 and use earlier entries.

Frobenius minus the identity lowers the lambda filtration by one; multiplication by q lowers it by q−1. The binomial induction fixes T_m under the q^r-th power of Frobenius, where m=1+(q−1)r and q^r≤N.

Ne belongs to lambda^(m−1)Lambda but not lambda^mLambda. Equal labels force an additional actual lattice division, contradicting this exact valuation; no prior equality of class and lattice chains is assumed.

Fractional ideals, compression, finite Riemann–Roch ansatz, local matrix orders and full global-section calculation avoid factoring supports. The fiber algebra is block upper triangular; trace-pairing radical gives rank-one idempotent; b^q lifts it and Ve=he gives the norm.

checks.mechanism: Effective class division and uniform cost
checks.evidence: Ramification normalization proves the norm promise. Orbit partial-sum maximum solves (1−sigma)V=E. Binary correcting-function circuits handle large infinity coefficients. Explicit dimension, degree, precision and scalar-grid bounds give O(B^500000+B^100 E^20), with numericalE.

fresh_controls.lattice_result: Exactly m−1 integral divisions, followed by failure of the next division, in every listed case.
